thread:
maya: Launching SAIL (sail-7b) to Hosted GA today 15:00 PT. Quick ops checklist + usage notes. TL;DR: new endpoint /v1/generate/sail, streaming + tool-calling supported, default per-key RPS moving 10 -> 8 (soft), burst 20 -> 16. Canary 10% initial.

maya: Ops checklist (short):
- Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/hosted/sail (migration + examples)
- New endpoint: POST /v1/generate/sail
- Streaming + tool-calls enabled by default for sail
- Rate-limit change (per-key): 10rps -> 8rps soft, burst 20 -> 16; contact eng-plat for exceptions
- Canary: 10% for 30m, promote to 30% if metrics OK, full after 2h
- Alerts: p50 latency > 120ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% triggers pager

tom: If rollback needed what's the fast path?

maya: Rollback is one command in redwoodctl. Example: 
```
redwoodctl deploy set-backend sail --version previous --force
```
Then stop routing traffic: 
```
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate/sail --weight 0
```
Do both and then open a deploy-rollback ticket.

irene: Canary plan: 10% -> 30% after 30m if checks pass -> 100% at ~2h. Autoscaler spike mode OFF for first hour, will enable after 2h if stable.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2025-07-12T15:00:05Z — canary allocation sail-hosted-1:10%

allan: Short client migration note (paste into SDK docs):
```
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/sail
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "input": "<user prompt>",
  "stream": true,
  "tool_calls": ["http_call", "file_write"]
}
```
Customers that explicitly pin the old route should continue to use their pinned model/path; unpinned keys will see sail when routed.

maya: Please watch dashboards (Console > Models > sail-7b) and escalate to #incidents immediately for any client-facing errors. Ping me directly for quota bump requests. Thanks all :rocket:
